title: A plain Opus ask in a prompt grants the one spawn it names; only `opus <time>` or `opus <role> <time>` stores a timed grant
why: A one-agent ask became a 2-hour all-roles grant the owner never meant.
source: Retrospective 14:13 CST Nov 13; owner 13:26 typed "send a blind opus agent to understand what are all the roles..." and 14:13 "opus override for this session? what are you talking about". Rule outcomes-grant-covers-named-act.
note: Filed 14:15 CST Nov 13. Red case (retrospective's reading, unread by triage): the local_time hook stored ~/.claude/state/override/opus/45763cdd-....json, written 19:26:53Z, until 21:26:49Z, role null, from that one ask. Fix: a plain Opus ask grants the one spawn it names; only `opus <time>` or `opus <role> <time>` stores a timed grant. Home: decision agent-model-cap (the local_time row) and hooks/local_time.py. Past work: items opus-plain-ask-scope (b) and opus-plain-ask-held (a) landed #1244 (batch 10), a plain ask scoped from earlier prompts; this step may narrow that. The leftover grant file on the owner's computer is his to clear or leave; triage cannot read it. HELD 14:16 CST Nov 13 (coordinator 14:27): it reverses owner item 601 a (12:54 CST Nov 12, record 618b84ece: "an Opus ask with no length lasts until the session ends or `opus off`"), which open draft #2928 (head 96416a2d6) builds. The owner's typed words do not say "one spawn": 13:26 "send a blind opus agent..." and 14:13 "opus override for this session? what are you talking about". The step's fix is the retrospective's reading. Asked as page item 761 (pick-opus-ask-one-spawn), b recommended. No lane until answered; if b, the lane stacks on #2928 (one home for the hook).
